Solution: The LLM emits special tokens when it determines that a function needs to be called and also emits the parameters to pass to that function. Context: Optimizing LLM inference for applications with repetitive or semantically similar user queries, where re-generating responses is inefficient.
Solution: Reuse previously generated responses (in the case of client-side caching) and/or model internal states (in the case of server-side caching) for the same or similar prompts. The similarity can be based on prompt meaning (semantic cache) or overlap (prefix caching).
